description: Through x, r100 and s100 each elide 2^100 terminators at boundary 0, so they are equal, and x has two least derivations. The two counts are built apart, so the comparison must take a run of equal positions whole, not one elision at a time. x loses to the empty alternative, which elides nothing (engine §6).
